en.headline: HKU and prisons find hepatitis C in 4.1 per cent of inmates screened
en.dek: A voluntary pilot at Stanley Prison with the Correctional Services Department reported a rate far above the 0.3 per cent in the general population; treated inmates cleared the virus.
body: The University of Hong Kong’s medical faculty and the Correctional Services Department said a voluntary hepatitis C screening and treatment pilot among inmates found a prevalence of 4.1 per cent, compared with about 0.3 per cent in the general Hong Kong population.

The programme began at Stanley Prison in October 2023. Researchers said more than 500 samples had been collected. Correctional Services senior superintendent for health care Wong Kai-tai said the higher rate among people in custody is in line with findings elsewhere, reflecting higher-risk behaviour before imprisonment such as sharing needles.

The faculty said inmates confirmed to have hepatitis C were treated and that the virus was cleared in all of those cases. Clinical associate professor Mak Long-yee, who led the pilot and a cost-effectiveness study, said modelling based on 10,000 inmates found that a one-off screening of serving prisoners, new admissions, or both, would be cost-effective compared with no screening.

Commercial Radio and Now News reported that the team’s model also pointed to reductions of more than 30 per cent in the risk of cirrhosis, liver cancer and death if screening and treatment were extended. The university said it is discussing a wider programme with relevant departments, while noting that staffing and supporting facilities remain constraints.

zh.headline: 港大懲教署篩查顯示在囚人士丙肝盛行率4.1%
zh.dek: 赤柱監獄自願先導計劃發現比率遠高於本港一般人口的0.3%，確診者經治療後病毒均被清除，團隊促擴展計劃。
body: 港大醫學院與懲教署公布，為在囚人士提供的自願丙型肝炎篩查及治療先導計劃，錄得盛行率4.1%，高於本港一般人口約0.3%。
計劃自2023年10月起在赤柱監獄推行，至今收集逾500個樣本。懲教署高級監督（健康護理）黃啟泰表示，在囚人士比率較高與其他地方情況相若，與入獄前較高風險行為例如共用針筒有關。
醫學院表示，確診丙肝的在囚人士其後接受治療，病毒均被清除。領導先導計劃及成本效益研究的臨床副教授麥龍兒指，團隊以1萬名在囚人士模擬，對在囚人士、新收納者或兩者進行一次性普遍篩查，相對不篩查具成本效益。
商業電台及Now新聞報道，團隊模型亦顯示若擴展篩查及治療，肝硬化、肝癌及死亡風險可降三成以上。院方正與相關部門商討擴展，但指人手和配套仍是限制。
